narratives.Description: fix(test): stub the #7252 slow-path gate in open-umbrella-warning test so it stays offline (#7265)
narratives.Overview:
## Problem

The nightly coverage lane (tracked by #7265) fails on one test: `packages/core/src/scope/open-umbrella-warning.test.ts:511`. `lifecycleMain(["complete", child, "--non-delivery", ...])` returns 1, not 0.

## Cause

#7252 added the slow-path gate `slowPathCompleteGateSeam.evaluate` (scope `main.ts`). With 2 eligible briefs the gate does live `gh` delivery lookups. The nightly coverage step has no `GH_TOKEN`, so the lookups fail and the gate refuses. PR CI has a token, so the test passes there but spends about 16 s on network. Reproduce with `GH_TOKEN=bad GH_HOST=invalid.example`.

`main.test.ts` (~1006-1022) already stubs the seam. Copy that pattern. Coverage thresholds are not at fault.

Refs #7265 #7252

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] open-umbrella-warning.test.ts replaces `slowPathCompleteGateSeam.evaluate` with `{ refuse: false }` for the complete test and restores it in `finally` (same pattern as main.test.ts), so the suite makes zero live `gh` calls.
- [ ] The test passes with `GH_TOKEN=bad GH_HOST=invalid.example`, and runs in under ~1 s locally.
- [ ] A grep sweep lists other test files that run `lifecycleMain complete` with 2+ active running briefs and no seam stub; each is fixed or confirmed unaffected.
- [ ] No threshold, workflow or product (main.ts) change.
